en: Published, visible, undeleted reviews during the period. Equal ratings share a rank. Loan counts use the same period; unrated books are excluded.

ru: Измените период или фильтры. Для книг без отзывов рейтинг не рассчитывается.
en: Change the period or filters. Ratings are never invented for books without reviews.
